title: No visible progress counter exists anywhere in status for 'two honest services to the Watch' (one of the four ways to earn the Regent's Writ / open Coldpass), unlike the explicit 'Hollows rested X/11' and 'Hollows burned X/11' counters for the other paths. I raised Watch reputation to 'trusted (+5)' through several favors (lighting the beacon, etc.) but never learned whether any of them counted as a discrete 'service', or how many I had.
